newsitem.title: USA: Warren Bancorp sells loans, sees gains.
newsitem.headline: Warren Bancorp sells loans, sees gains.

text.p: Warren Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it will recognize a one-time tax benefit of about $760,000, or $0.19 a share, in the fourth quarter.
The forecast was based on the company's analysis of the Fresh Start provisions of the recently enacted Small Business job Projection Act of 1996.

The company also announced it made an agreement in prenciple to sell its rights to service about $212 million of residential mortgage loans. This represents the entire portfolio of loans serviced for others.

It will continue to service loans it currently owns. The transaction, which is expected to close by January 31, 1997, will produce an after-tax gain of about $1.3 million, or $0.33 a share, in the first quarter of 1997.
